paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.67% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.67%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-1.42%). Brent crude changed -1.41% to 102.14. Gold changed +2.64% to 4,044.3. Bitcoin changed +1.00% to 78,121.8672. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of +1.19%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (-4.95%) and Vale (-3.17%) moved the most.
